title: Special Weather Statement
location: Edgecombe; Johnston; Wilson; Wayne

details.description:

a line extending from near Elm City to 8 miles south of Smithfield.
Movement was east at 45 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph and half inch hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Goldsboro, Wilson, Elm City, Fremont, Pinetops, Kenly, Princeton,

details.instruction:

These thunderstorms are producing an excessive amount of deadly cloud
to ground lightning. Seek shelter indoors and stay away from windows.
If you cannot seek shelter indoors, an enclosed vehicle can provide
safe shelter. Deadly lightning strikes can occur well ahead of an
approaching storm, prior to the arrival of rain and wind.

title: Flash Flood Warning
location: Mitchell, TX; Scurry, TX

details.description:
FFWMAF

The National Weather Service in Midland/Odessa has extended the

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Eastern Mitchell County in western Texas...
South Central Scurry County in western Texas...

* Until 1145 PM CDT.

* At 1031 PM CDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 2 and 4.5 inches of rain
have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible
in portions of the warned area. Flash flooding is already
occurring.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Colorado City, Loraine, Champion Creek Reservoir, Lake Colorado
City, Lake Colorado City State Park, Colorado City Airport,
Westbrook, Buford and Dunn.
details.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

details.description:

index values between 108 and 111 degrees for several hours
Sunday afternoon and early evening. A few locations may briefly

light weight and light colored clothing, and take frequent breaks
from the heat. Young children and pets should never be left
unattended in vehicles.

Northeastern El Paso County in western Texas...

title: Flash Flood Warning
location: Coconino, AZ

details.description:
At 753 PM MST /853 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms
were weakening. Heavy rain that fell earlier across the warned area
produced between 2.0 and 3.0 inches in about and hours. As a result,
flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes and roads.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Grand Falls and Wolf Crossing.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Little Colorado River and San Francisco Wash.
details.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable.

title: Flash Flood Warning
location: Coconino, AZ

details.description:
FFWFGZ

The National Weather Service in Flagstaff has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Coconino County in north central Arizona...

* Until 1045 PM MST /1145 PM MDT/.

* At 749 PM MST /849 PM MDT/, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms

inches of rain have fallen. Additional rainfall amounts of 0.25 to

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
normally dry washes and roads.

Mainly rural areas of Coconino County.

This includes the following creeks, washes and rivers...
Paiute Trail Wash, Tonahakaad Spring, Dinnebito Wash, Little
Colorado River and Landmark Wash.
details.instruction:
Flooding of washes and creeks will occur, some dirt roads will become
muddy and impassable.

title: Heat Advisory
location: Wayne; Perry; Greene; Stone; George

details.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 108 expected.

* WHERE...George, Greene, Perry, Stone, and Wayne Counties.

* WHEN...From 10 AM to 7 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
details.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

title: Heat Advisory
location: Beadle; Gregory; Jerauld; Sanborn; Brule; Aurora; Davison; Hanson; Charles Mix; Douglas; Hutchinson; Bon Homme; Yankton

details.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 103 expected.

* WHERE...Portions of central, east central, south central, and
southeast South Dakota.

* WHEN...From 1 PM to 9 PM CDT Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
details.instruction:
Do not leave young children and pets in unattended vehicles. Car
interiors will reach lethal temperatures in a matter of minutes.

Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.

To reduce risk during outdoor work, the Occupational Safety and
Health Administration recommends scheduling frequent rest breaks in
shaded or air conditioned environments. Anyone overcome by heat
should be moved to a cool and shaded location. Heat stroke is an
emergency! Call 9 1 1.

title: Flash Flood Warning
location: Bibb, GA; Jones, GA; Twiggs, GA

details.description:
FFWFFC

The National Weather Service in Peachtree City has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Bibb County in central Georgia...
Southeastern Jones County in central Georgia...
Northwestern Twiggs County in central Georgia...

* Until 430 AM EDT.

* At 1036 PM EDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain
have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 2.5 to 4.5 inches in 1
hour. Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Macon, Payne, Payne City, Cross Keys, Franklinton, Rutland, Dry
Branch, Postell, Wesleyan, Skipperton, Griswoldville, Huber, Middle
Georgia Regional Airport, Arkwright and Mountain Springs.
details.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be especially cautious at night when it is harder to recognize the
dangers of flooding.

title: Air Quality Alert
location: Extreme Western Allegany; Central and Eastern Allegany; Western Garrett; Eastern Garrett

details.description:
The Maryland Department of the Environment has issued a Code
ORANGE Air Quality Alert Monday for Western Maryland.

A Code Orange Air Quality Alert means that air pollution
concentrations within the region may become unhealthy for
sensitive groups. Sensitive groups include children, people
suffering from asthma, heart disease or other lung diseases and
the elderly. The effects of air pollution can be minimized by
avoiding strenuous activity or exercise outdoors.

For more information on ground-level ozone
and fine particles visit the web site
mde.maryland.gov/programs/air/AirQualityMonitoring/Pages/index.aspx
